lines.text: Sales teams make confident promises. Small businesses need evidence before they commit. Meet SecondLook.
Paste a claim in English or Spanish. The first look searches the live web with Linkup.
Nebius identifies the missing proof and proposes a targeted follow-up. Product availability does not prove that every competitor uses it.
RevenueCat runs the test checkout. A failed purchase keeps the first look intact. A valid test purchase unlocks further research.
The server verifies access. Nebius builds findings with exact source passages, then checks whether those passages justify the conclusion.
Here, the answer is insufficient evidence. Inspect the sources, ask the right questions, and keep the decision brief.
SecondLook. Before you buy, check the proof.
